expectedIssues: Middle card in the carousel is not aligned with the other cards
reportedIssues: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right screen edge and its title is truncated mid-word with no ellipsis, making it look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
The category filter chip row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') is also clipped at the right edge with a partially visible chip, giving an unfinished appearance.
The notification bell icon relies on a small red dot with no text or badge count, which may be missed by users and is not clearly announced to screen readers.
Delivery fee and time metadata use inconsistent formatting across cards (e.g., '€0.90 delivery' under the title vs. '€0 delivery' as a badge on the image), which can cause mild confusion.

expected.reasoning: The reported clipping of a card at the carousel edge describes the same carousel card layout/alignment defect.
